slot_note: re-root of the number: architecture 1 (the battery cycling threshold carried from a hub's long price record, general-statistics-data-science) spent at the 2026-11-02 re-check; architecture 2 drawn in physical-environmental-sciences (emissions-inventory), a fuel terminal's 2026 loading VOC, in a new world, dataset and prompt shell
niche: a regional fuel distributor's licence return for 2026 at its bulk fuel terminal: the VOC its loading bays released, conformed from two terminal automation exports across a July cutover, the dispatch system's delivery dockets, the vapour recovery unit's outlet log and the tanker register, where the multi-product retail fleet loads diesel at the two uncontrolled distillate bays into compartments that last delivered petrol through service stations' vapour balance
analyst_test: With both terminal automation exports conformed, every docket read and the licence's vapour tables applied, a strong analyst sums each bay's litres by product, charges them by the loading-loss equation at each product's own vapour pressure (diesel's is negligible) and adds the vapour recovery unit's measured outlet for the petrol bays, filing about 1.4 tonnes for 2026, well inside the 20-tonne loading limit, because nothing asks what each compartment held when its diesel went in.
domain_test: A loading emissions inventory worked the way an air quality engineer works it, each load releasing the vapour its liquid displaces at the saturation that vapour already carries, so a compartment that delivered petrol through a station's vapour balance arrives full of saturated petrol vapour whatever it loads next; with another field's nouns there is no vapour space, no vapour balance and no displacement, and nothing would make one load's release depend on the delivery before it.
layer2_pattern: own:loading release charged to each compartment fill by the vapour its previous delivery left, petrol vapour returned through station vapour balance displaced at uncontrolled distillate bays
layer1: two terminal automation exports across the 1 July 2026 cutover: the old one in gross observed litres with a volume correction factor column and trailer plates, the new one in net litres at 15 C with the system's own tanker ids and B-double compartments numbered through

the dispatch system's delivery dockets timestamped in UTC against the terminal's local time (AEST, AEDT from October), one docket line per compartment drop, the partner terminal's lifting numbers on exchange trips
a tanker register whose plates changed at re-registration and whose old system access cards were reissued at the cutover
the vapour recovery unit's 15-minute outlet log with an analyser swap in May (ppm as propane before, mg per cubic metre after) and flagged calibration intervals
cancelled and re-issued bills of lading, product codes renamed when E10 replaced the old ULP 91 code in March
stakeholder_role: the terminal manager, who signs the licence's annual return

spine.entity: one compartment's drop at one delivery site

world.geography: Australia (a fictional regional port city, Warrenby)
world.org_type: regional fuel distributor with its own bulk terminal, retail tanker fleet and a contract carrier

driver: Each transfer into a container pushes out whatever the container already held, so the release charged to a transfer is set by the container's previous use rather than by what the transfer puts in; the field's factor charges each transfer by its own contents, and only each container's own sequence of uses, read from the record of where it was last emptied, shows which transfers pushed out the earlier contents.
driver_concrete: Diesel loaded at the uncontrolled distillate bays pushes out the vapour its compartment held when loading began, and a retail compartment that last delivered petrol through a station's vapour balance comes back full of saturated petrol vapour; the loading-loss equation at diesel's own vapour pressure files the two bays at a fraction of a tonne, while charging each diesel fill by its compartment's previous delivery in the dispatch dockets (petrol lifted at the partner terminal included) files them at tens of tonnes and puts the terminal over its loading limit.
stump: The default path charges every diesel load at diesel's own vapour pressure and files about 1.4 tonnes of VOC from loading for 2026, inside the 20-tonne limit; but the retail compartments that last delivered petrol through station vapour balance push saturated petrol vapour out at the uncontrolled distillate bays, so the terminal released tens of tonnes and exceeded its limit.

differentiation.task488: task488 recovers new items' difficulties from the responses of the members each item was given to by its recorded level, a selection on the estimated quantity; here nothing is selected or estimated: each diesel fill releases the vapour its own compartment's previous delivery left, a state carried between consecutive uses of one container and read per fill from the dispatch record.
differentiation.task308: task308 v3 credits an added generating unit with its availability in the hours that matter, when units of its kind fail together from a shared cause; here nothing fails or moves together: each diesel fill displaces the vapour its own compartment's previous delivery left, a state carried between consecutive uses of one container and read per fill from the dispatch record.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at the re-check under the new gates: the node's-own-year reading is either refuted by the data, and then every pooled extension is unanimous on the golden and the golden is the field's textbook long-record correction (Reflex fails, standing spread zero), or it stays open on the current windy stretch's persistence and is a fork whose only closing sentence names the record the step recognises (the fork is the stump); the shipped cut also failed leak.py (dictionary and manifest) and precut, and guard heart BLOCKed
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a low quantile of a distribution seen directly only over one short and unrepresentative period; the long record of a correlated auxiliary series, carried to the target through the proportional relationship their overlap shows, gives the distribution over the full range of conditions, while the short record alone, the auxiliary record alone or the auxiliary shifted by an additive offset each set the dial at a different value.
lineage.stump: The default path sets the threshold from the node's own day-ahead spreads since MPI first priced it (eleven windy months whose average looks ordinary but a third of whose days were flat) and picks $15; the hub's eight years alone pick $10 and the hub plus the node's average spread premium $30; carrying the hub's eight weather years to the node through the proportional relationship their overlap shows picks $20.
lineage.niche: an independent storage owner's 2027 cycling threshold for a 100 MW / 400 MWh battery at a congested node: the node's daily day-ahead spread distribution, seen directly for only eleven months since the node was created, integrated with the trading hub's eight-year record through their overlap
